reason: The evaluator opened its own SQLite integrity-check connection with a transaction context manager, which does not close the connection. On Windows that evaluator-owned handle prevented TemporaryDirectory cleanup during persistence-check teardown. The candidate server was already stopped. Explicitly close the evaluator connection; retain all assertions, inputs and required results unchanged. Apply this same corrected evaluator to both arms. No candidate repair or feedback.
original_reporting_limit: The evaluator overwrites a check status on teardown error, so the first report alone does not preserve that check's pre-teardown assertion status. The corrected rerun supplies the scored result.
